Alice (Product): Heads-up — customer X wants to upgrade to model-x-v2 which returns 1536-d embeddings instead of 1024. Need a PRD for how we handle dim changes for reranking + migration options. Thoughts?
Ben (ML Eng): Oof. Two main paths: 1) force reindex (recompute all stored vectors) 2) provide compatibility layer that projects 1536->1024 (or vice versa) at query time. Both have cost/latency tradeoffs.
Carol (Eng-ML Lead): Agree. Also normalization differences: new model uses unit L2 norm, old didn't. That affects cosine scores. We should include explicit acceptance criteria for ranking quality.
Dan (Infra): Operational constraints: reindexing 10s of millions is doable but needs throttled background jobs + rollback. Compatibility layer adds latency at query path; we should quantify. Does the API allow mixed-dim batches today?
Ben (ML Eng): Current embed API expects consistent dim per request. Batch semantics: we either reject mixed-dim batches or auto-split. For realtime rerank we must avoid per-request model transforms that add >10ms p95.
Emily (Data Scientist): From evals: mapping 1536->1024 using PCA loses ~2.5% MRR on internal test; simple linear projection with small retrain is ~1% drop. Must set guardrails: max allowed regression 1.5% MRR or revert.
Alice (Product): Good. Drafting PRD checklist: - migration modes (reindex, projection, dual-serve) - rollout plan (canary, 10% traffic -> 50% -> 100%) - acceptance criteria (quality & latency) - storage schema changes (version tag) - customer opt-in/out policy - telemetry & alerts
Carol (Eng-ML Lead): Suggest we require bundle: model_id + embed_dim in vector metadata. That way reranker always knows which projector to apply. Also store "embed_schema_version" on index docs.
Ben (ML Eng): Example acceptance criteria (proposal): ```
- Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR) on holdout set must not drop >1.0% relative to baseline
- P95 query latency increase must be <= 10ms
- Reindex job error rate < 0.1% and can be paused/resumed
- Provide transparent per-customer migration ETA and cost estimate
```
Dan (Infra): For batch semantics, my proposal: API returns 400 if mixed dims in same call, with helpful error: "mixed_embed_dims: include model_id or send separate calls". We can also accept mixed dims if client sets mode=async and we internally split into sub-batches. That keeps fast path simple.
Emily (Data Scientist): Edge cases to include in RFC: - dimension mismatch for stored vs query vector - normalization mismatch (unit L2 vs none) - upstream clients accidentally sending wrong shape - older customers with no reindex budget - embeddings stored in third-party vector DBs (we need export/import guidance)
Alice (Product): Launch criteria: must support at least one safe migration path without >1.5% quality regression for top-1 rerank on customer benchmarks, and must have console UI to schedule reindex and show progress.
Ben (ML Eng): Implementation options: 1) Projection microservice (fast linear proj optimized on GPU) 2) Reindex worker + streaming snapshot for near-zero downtime 3) Dual-serving: both dims served and results ensembled. Each has different infra costs.
Carol (Eng-ML Lead): We should add acceptance test in CI: synthetic corpus, run rerank baseline vs new flow, assert metrics. Also add opt-out header on API for safety.
Dan (Infra): Operational checklist: quota for background reindex, job sharding plan, rate limiter, data integrity checksums, rollback by timestamp. Need separate ticket for datastore schema migration (embed_dim index).
Alice (Product): Customer negotiation notes: tell them reindex cost estimate + option to pay for managed reindex. Offer temporary projection for free for 30 days.
Emily (Data Scientist): Also note: cosine vs dot product differences if we change normalization. Add acceptance: "scaled scores preserved within 5% after normalization correction".
Ben (ML Eng): Quick API examples to include in RFC: ```json
POST /v1/embeddings
{"model":"model-x-v2","input":["a","b"]}
// response: {"embedding": [ ... 1536 floats ... ], "dim":1536}

POST /v1/embeddings/batch
// if mixed dims -> 400 with message and suggestion to set ?async_split=true
```
Alice (Product): Next steps: Ben/Carol draft RFC with options + cost estimates. Dan to outline infra effort. Emily to run small projection experiments on customer X dataset for numbers. I'll draft PRD doc with launch criteria + negotiation playbook. Can we have a first pass by EOD Friday? :thumbsup:
Carol (Eng-ML Lead): I'll start RFC skeleton today. Adding skeleton acceptance tests.
Ben (ML Eng): I'll run perf for projection microservice and measure p95 impact.
Dan (Infra): I'll scope reindex worker and schema migration.

Emily (Data Scientist): Running projection evals now, will post results in thread when ready. :eyes:
